titles: 15 Things Kids Did Alone in the 1960s That Are Unthinkable Today
Growing Up in the 60s: 15 Things We Did Alone That Shock Parents Now
15 Things Kids Did ALONE in the 1960s — Parents Today Would Panic
description_intro:
Growing up in the 60s meant a kind of freedom most children today will never know. We walked to school at six, rode our bikes clear across town with no helmet, ran to the corner store with a note from Mom, and stayed out until the streetlights came on.

In this video, we count down 15 things kids did alone in the 1960s, from trick-or-treating with no grown-ups to the paper route at eleven, in towns and cities all across the United States and Canada.

Which of these did you do on your own? Tell us where you grew up. We read every comment.
